comment: The Prism's realizability: every spec field changes some answer, every rule answers somewhere it alone decides, and every facet carries a complete eleven-element descriptor. tools/realize/gate.py reads this file and every app/specs/*/spec.json, writes PrismRealizability(.Proofs).lex.tex, and gives tools/prism_root.py one witness pair per field, which the compiled guest replays as acceptance vectors.
